description: Real data, nothing made up: the first recording the record workflow published, recordings/20261111160917-3c228907aa129a01/ on observatory-data at commit 9d165dd. tape.jsonl, run.json and SHA256SUMS are those three files, byte for byte. It holds what one RPC endpoint answered to the 52 calls of recordings/requests.json at that list's sha256: evidence for building the decoder, never proof of chain state (RULES.md section 8).
